ul.li: After creating the instance, please make sure you complete all the other necessary configurations such as Tax, Warehouse, Pricelist etc. from the Shopify setting screen.

i.title: Use this button to set your Shopify OAuth details in Odoo. The authorization link will be generated from your Shopify Partner account.
Select the Shopify store to configure. All settings below apply to the selected store only.

block.title: Global Settings (Applicable to All Stores)
block.name: shopify_global_block
block.invisible: not shopify_instance_id or shopify_config_tab not in ['all', 'global']

setting.string: Use Sales Description of Odoo Product

i.title: If checked, the Odoo product's Sales Description will be included in the Shopify product description. - This configuration applies to all Shopify stores, not to a particular one. - The description received from Shopify is in HTML format, while it is stored in Odoo as plain text. Enable this only if it works for you. - The Sales Description will be used in sale order lines. Note that descriptions from Shopify are often lengthy, so enable this only if it suits your workflow. - When a new product is created from Shopify, the description will be set in the Odoo product's Sales Description field. - When an Odoo product is exported to Shopify, the Sales Description will be added to the Shopify product's Description field.

button.name: download_shopify_net_profit_report_module
button.help: Install this module to enable Net Profit reporting for all stores.

i.title: - Enabling this will add the Net Profit Report for all stores. - Disabling this will automatically remove the Net Profit Report. - You can find the Shopify Net Profit Report under Shopify > Reporting > Net Profit. - The report is calculated based on instance-level settings and analytic accounts.
- If checked, Odoo's default Terms & Conditions will be applied under Sales Order notes. - If unchecked, the Sales Order note will be imported from the Shopify order response.

- If enabled, system-generated HTTP log lines from Shopify REST API calls (pyactiveresource) will be suppressed. - Connector logs and all WARNING / ERROR level logs are never affected. - GraphQL-based stores do not use pyactiveresource and are unaffected by this setting.

block.title: General Configuration
block.invisible: not shopify_instance_id or shopify_config_tab not in ['all', 'general']

i.title: The selected Warehouse will be assigned to your Shopify orders.
Select the language for your Shopify store.
If checked, it will enable the Shopify Markets feature for this store.

block.title: Product Configuration
block.invisible: not shopify_instance_id or shopify_config_tab not in ['all', 'product']

i.title: - If enabled, a new product will be created in your catalog if the system cannot find a match based on SKU, Internal Reference, or Default Product Code. - If you sell on multiple sales channels with different SKU / Internal Reference / Default Product Code values, this may result in duplicate products in your catalog. - We recommend enabling this option based on your product catalog configuration.
If checked, product images will be automatically synced during product import.
During product sync from Shopify to Odoo, products will be matched based on the selected method.

1. During product sync, prices will be imported/exported using this Pricelist. 2. During order sync, this Pricelist will be applied to the order if the store's order currency matches the currency configured in this Pricelist.
During product sync import and export operations, the Compare At prices will be imported/exported using this Pricelist.
Select the Unit of Measure used to convert Shopify product weight.
If checked, the product weight will be synced from Shopify to Odoo during product import and update.
If checked, product categories will be automatically created during product import.
During product sync import and export operations, the product category selected here will be assigned to the Shopify product layer.
If checked, product tags will be automatically created during product import.

i.title: Select the order statuses for which you want to import orders from your Shopify store to Odoo.
Only orders created after this date will be imported from Shopify.

Enter a prefix to be added to order numbers imported from Shopify.
Select the Sales Team to be assigned to Shopify orders.
This customer will be assigned to POS orders that do not have a customer specified.
If checked, orders will be imported based on the customer's presentment (visible) currency — the currency the customer used to make the payment.
If checked, a Company-type partner will be created from the company name, and the customer will be linked as a contact (child partner) under that company.
If checked, customers will be notified when the order status is changed.

If checked, order fulfillment status will be updated based on multiple warehouses in your Shopify store.

block.title: Buy with Prime
block.invisible: not shopify_instance_id or shopify_config_tab not in ['all', 'order']

i.title: If checked, Buy with Prime orders will be imported from Shopify.
The selected Warehouse will be assigned to Buy with Prime orders.
Select the tags to be applied when importing Buy with Prime orders.

setting.string: Force Transfer for Buy with Prime

i.title: If checked, stock moves will be forcefully validated even when sufficient stock is not available in Odoo.

block.title: Analytic Accounting
block.invisible: not shopify_instance_id or shopify_config_tab not in ['all', 'order']

i.title: Enable this option if you want to use Analytic Accounting for Shopify orders.

Set the Analytic Account for Shopify orders. Note: The analytic account configured here will be applied to all sales orders created by the connector. When this is set, Odoo's Analytic Default Rules will not apply to Shopify order invoices. If you wish to use Odoo's Analytic Default Rules instead, leave this field empty.

block.title: Webhook Configuration
block.invisible: not shopify_instance_id or shopify_config_tab not in ['all', 'webhook']

setting.div: How webhooks work: Enabling a webhook registers it in Shopify for all related events (create / update / delete). Disabling deactivates it. Only instances with an https:// URL are supported. For advanced options open the Webhooks tab on the Instance record (Shopify › Configuration › Instances).

i.title: Enable this to automatically sync product changes (create, update, delete) from Shopify to Odoo via webhook.
Enable this to automatically sync customer changes (create, update, delete) from Shopify to Odoo via webhook.
Enable this to automatically sync order changes (create, update, delete) from Shopify to Odoo via webhook.

block.title: Order Webhook — Automation Rules
block.invisible: not shopify_instance_id or not create_shopify_orders_webhook or shopify_config_tab not in ['all', 'webhook']

i.title: If enabled, delivery orders in Odoo will be automatically validated when orders are marked as shipped in Shopify.
If enabled, delivery orders will be automatically validated even when inventory is not available in Odoo. Note: This feature does not apply to products tracked by Lots or Serial Numbers.
If enabled, a credit note will be automatically created in Odoo when a refund is initiated directly in Shopify.
If enabled, a Return will be automatically generated in Odoo when a refund is initiated directly in Shopify.
If enabled, the Return will be automatically validated in Odoo.
If enabled, payment will be automatically registered for the credit note.
The selected Journal will be used for registering credit note payments.
If enabled, customer information in existing orders will be automatically updated. Note: This feature does not apply to orders that have already been shipped or invoiced.

If enabled, order line quantities in imported orders will be automatically updated when quantities are changed manually in Shopify. Note: This feature does not apply to orders that have already been shipped in Odoo.

setting.string: Auto Invoice/Credit Note on Qty Change

i.title: If enabled, an invoice or credit note will be automatically created based on the quantity change made in Shopify.

setting.string: Add New Products to Existing Orders

i.title: If enabled, new products will be automatically added to imported sales orders when they are manually added from the Shopify store.

block.title: Tax Configuration
block.invisible: not shopify_instance_id or shopify_config_tab not in ['all', 'tax']

i.title: 1) Odoo Default Tax Behaviour — Taxes are applied based on Odoo's default tax and fiscal position configuration. 2) Create New Tax If Not Found — The system will search for matching tax data received from Shopify in Odoo, and create a new tax if no match is found.

Use Shopify Tax: Odoo exports only the untaxed unit price and quantity. Tax lines from Odoo are not exported, regardless of whether taxes are inclusive or exclusive. If quantity is updated in Odoo and synced to Shopify, only the quantity is updated — price and tax are recalculated by Shopify. Use Odoo Tax: Odoo exports the tax amounts to Shopify at the time of order export. These exported taxes are treated as fixed values and will not be recalculated or changed in Shopify.
Select the Tax Grid to be used when creating taxes imported from Shopify.
Set the credit tax account. This account will be applied to newly created taxes when importing orders from Shopify to Odoo.
Set the invoice tax account. This account will be applied to newly created taxes when importing orders from Shopify to Odoo.
If enabled, a Tax Group will be automatically created whenever a new tax is created in Odoo.
For Tax Group: This account is used as the counterpart in the Tax Closing Entry when the balance is in favor of the tax authorities (amount owed to authorities).
For Tax Group: This account is used as the counterpart in the Tax Closing Entry when the balance is in favor of the company (amount owed to the company).

block.title: Inventory
block.invisible: not shopify_instance_id or shopify_config_tab not in ['all', 'inventory']

i.title: Select the inventory quantity field to use for syncing stock with Shopify. Forecasted Quantity = Quantity On Hand - Outgoing + Incoming Free to Use Quantity = Quantity On Hand - Reserved Quantity

Works only for products whose Bill of Materials type is 'Manufacture this product' or 'Subcontracting'. If enabled, stock for such products will be imported/updated from Shopify. This setting has no effect on Kit type BOMs: a kit's stock is always auto-computed from its components in Odoo and cannot be set directly, so kit products are always skipped regardless of this setting.

Select the type of activity to be created when an error occurs.
Select the users who will be responsible for the scheduled activity.
Enter the number of lead days for calculating the deadline date of the scheduled activity.

block.invisible: not shopify_instance_id or shopify_config_tab not in ['all', 'activities']
